kcc_query_text_example: ST marginal dryland farmer with 1.8 acres rainfed ragi in Pavagada taluk, Tumakuru; severe recurring drought; applying for Krishi Honda farm pond under Krishi Bhagya with 90% ST subsidy; also asking about Valmiki corporation borewell scheme eligibility.

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Pavagada taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka: Arid rainfed ragi and millet tracts in eastern Pavagada/Sira taluks of Tumakuru, severe water table depletion and high farm-pond intervention density.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka water conservation query logs: Tribal smallholders in Pavagada seeking Krishi Bhagya farm ponds and Valmiki Corporation borewell assistance.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Evaluates Krishi Bhagya farm pond package on marginal dryland ST holding (1.8 ac in [1.0, 12.35] interval in notified rainfed Tumakuru district), confirming statutory scheme eligibility; historical guidelines provided 90% ST subsidy rate, but current FY 2026-27 component rates and financial ceilings remain unverified pending official Government Order; evaluates Ganga Kalyana Valmiki ST Corporation Individual Route where raw engine fires GK_SCH010_VALMIKI_INDIVIDUAL_ROUTE_VALID (1.2 <= 1.8 <= 5.0 ac); CRITICAL SAFEGUARD: SCH010_VALMIKI is provisional in registry, so governance decouples raw ELIGIBLE and routes to Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION without numerical scoring.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate Krishi Bhagya farm pond package on marginal dryland ST holding; qualify subsidy rate as pending current-year GO verification; enforce provisional governance safeguard routing raw ELIGIBLE Valmiki ST borewell to Section B.
unresolved_dependencies: Current FY 2026-27 Government Order confirming exact Krishi Bhagya component-wise subsidy percentage and financial ceiling for ST smallholders in Tumakuru district
Karnataka Maharshi Valmiki Scheduled Tribes Development Corporation annual circular specifying individual borewell target allocations for Pavagada taluk
